scope:
Exact-source B2 helper-only mutation projection, never a whole-checker gate.

Selected newly named helpers are physical entry-source declarations. Every
remaining runtime declaration/load is a dependency, including modified old
call sites. Only authored B2 checks run. Moved old bodies are labeled below;
this does not claim mutation qualification of the old modified call sites.

selected_helpers.name: CB_call_values
selected_helpers.scope: moved existing call-substitution body, independently included in selected scope

selected_helpers.name: CB_alias_writes_mode
selected_helpers.scope: mostly moved existing alias-write body plus external-witness mode

selected_checks.title: return borrow local aliases project writes by backing and selected field
return borrow parameter aliases preserve formal identity and descriptor paths
return borrow unknown alias origins preserve both manual status and known writes
return borrow alias indexing validates logical owners writes and target extents
return borrow descriptor-only queries preserve the prior lower bound without inspecting writes
return borrow resolved helper endpoints substitute only supplied actuals and refuse type conflict
return borrow storage behind a passed-on helper slice stays the caller's view or local array
B2 helper writes keep selected caller facts default empty recursion and original local witnesses
B2 write query uses ordinary bounded memo workspace and preserves active unknown
B2 helper descent obeys the existing depth bound and restores it on refusal
B2 collector preserves exact paths disjoint owners prefix bounds and first failures
B2 unknown destination and source alternatives preserve selected known terms
B2 presence-only scans retain their admitted maximum aggregate depth
B2 static call sources survive substitution and existing errors keep first witness
B2 receiver ordinal and earlier bad writes cannot be hidden by a later safe call
B2 raw return composition and retained-only manual boundary preserve known facts
B2 retained opacity skips only already incomplete facts within the same work
